MTS is a Run Time Assurance (RTA) tool based on the Testing Autonomy in Complex Environments (TACE) code base created by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab (JHU APL). MTS is used at Edwards AFB to safely test autonomous control of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the government. 1.1.1 Description of Services/Objectives. The contractor shall provide all management, personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportatio

ion. 1.6.3 Delivered product shall integrate A-GRA autonomy interface into the existing MTS Service Set creation tool. Upon selection of A-GRA, the Mission Planner Autonomy UI must dynamically reconfigure connection parameter fields (e.g., IPs, Ports, Serial) to match the A- GRA interface format and auto -populate with appropriate default values. Description of Requirements for the items/Services to be acquired: The requirement is for molecular testing for thyroid specimens, please reference attached statement of work (SOW). The contractor shall provide molecular testing for thyroid specimens to assess cancer risk in cases with indeterminate results. Testing shall be accurate, completed within 14 days, and compliant with all regulations. The contractor shall supply all materials for specimen collection and transport, report results directly to the VA, submit invoices electronically. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

f_Work.docx ===== STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) RFID Cabinet The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), requires the acquisition of a Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) storage cabinet integrated with Unique Device Identifier (UDI)-compliant tissue and implant tracking software to support patient safety, regulatory compliance, and efficient inventory management. Tracking tissues, biologics, and implantable medical devices is a federal regulatory requirement under FDA 21 CFR Part 830 (UDI) and is critical to patient safety. VA healthcare facilities face ongoing resource challenges including staff shortages and budget constraints, making it essential to minimize staff time consumed by manual data entry and to maintain precise control over high-value inventory. This acquisition will provide an automated, real-time RFID-based inventory management solution for use in the operating room (OR), Catheterization (Cath) lab, ambulatory surgery center, or any facility location that stores high-value implantable inventory. Scope: To procure secured shielding cabinets for radioactive sources with specific interior dimensions and shielding materials. 1.1 Background: Current facilities do not support storage of the required sample sources and operations are moving to a new building without existing storage infrastructure. Cabinets must be provided before the move can occur. 2. Applicable Documents. Background: AFIT does not have a complete system for safely controlling the flow of gases into lab 640/275, venting the gas lines in the event of an emergency, nor is the exhaust rated or matched in capacity for research projects. certifications_partner.text: ck: Provide an Instructor Operator Station (IOS) interface allowing instructors to monitor trainee viewpoints in real-time, inject faults on the fly, draw virtual annotations, and take control of scenarios. The system must support remote mentorship capabilities where a dispersed Subject Matter Expert (SME) can view what the maintainer sees in real-time. 6.1.8 Minimal Hardware Footprint and Network Compliance: The physical components of the VMT must fit within company-level maintenance shops and existing SOATB classrooms. The software must run without requiring active wireless components to meet strict SOCOM cyber security and network accreditation standards. 6.2 Prioritized Maintenance Tasks (Stand-Alone Sim) The VMT must realistically simulate the visual, spatial, and mechanical interaction required to perform the following critical tasks: 1. Task V-2410: Major Component Procedural Rehearsals: Step-by-step guided and unguided removal, inspection, disassembly, and installation of major 2410-tracked components, specifically including turbine engines and transmissions. 2. Task V-3100: Interactive Fault Diagnosis & Troubleshooting: End-to-end troubleshooting loops for electrical faults, hydraulic systems, cockpit avionics failures, and powerplant malfunctions.
